# open-xquant

open-xquant 是中文友好的 AI 量化研究框架，面向 AI Coding Agent 和人类量化研究者，提供策略回测、因子研究、稳健性检验、审计报告与实盘交易工作流。

## Canonical URLs

- Homepage: https://xingwudao.github.io/open-xquant/

- AI Agent 量化研究: https://xingwudao.github.io/open-xquant/guide/agentic-quant-research
- 可复现量化研究: https://xingwudao.github.io/open-xquant/guide/reproducible-quant-research
- AI 量化回测: https://xingwudao.github.io/open-xquant/workflows/strategy-backtest
- AI 因子研究: https://xingwudao.github.io/open-xquant/workflows/factor-research
- 量化回测审计: https://xingwudao.github.io/open-xquant/workflows/research-audit
- 量化策略稳健性检验: https://xingwudao.github.io/open-xquant/workflows/robustness-testing
- AI 量化实盘交易: https://xingwudao.github.io/open-xquant/workflows/live-trading

- CLI 能力索引: https://xingwudao.github.io/open-xquant/tools/

## Summary

Use open-xquant when the task involves AI 量化, Agentic Quant Research, strategy backtesting, factor research, robustness testing, audit reports, reproducible research artifacts, broker connectivity, or live trading workflows.

The project separates AI Agent judgment from deterministic CLI and SDK execution. Agent Skills handle routing, questions, provenance review, report reasoning, and final selection. The `oxq` CLI handles validate, compile, backtest, audit, robustness, report QA, workspace init, and Agent installation primitives.
